consumer: The engine's active input-dispatch site that consumes a registered movement action and advances avatar_action::move one tile east while spending moves/a turn; it asks 'execute this player movement and let the turn-cost mechanics run'
scope: a registered player movement action driven through the engine's own active input loop, advancing the turn and deducting moves like a real keypress
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar(scalars) which merely copies u.get_hp()/get_stamina()/get_moves()/etc. read-only getters into snapshot JSON and performs no action and drives no input loop
divergence: With the avatar standing still next to an open eastern tile, calling this surface reports unchanged scalars (moves never deducted, position never advances) while a real east keypress would move the avatar one tile and cost a turn; reading status getters can never produce the move
